pages.lesson:
LESSON: GUIDED WRITING: IMAGINATIVE WRITING

Grade: Grade 7
Subject: ARABIC
Strand: Writing 3.3 Guided Writing: Paragraph Writing (2 sessions) • Forming simple para
Topic 3.5: Guided Writing: Imaginative Writing

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Guided Writing: Imaginative Writing. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: How can you develop a creative text?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. identify features of imaginative writing for information
2. create a short personal and imaginative text to express ideas on the theme
3. appreciate different creative Arabic writing styles

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE LEARNING: GUIDED WRITING: IMAGINATIVE WRITING
This lesson teaches Guided Writing: Imaginative Writing for Grade 7 ARABIC.

STUDY STEPS
1. identify features of imaginative writing for information
   Practise this until you can do it without help.
2. create a short personal and imaginative text to express ideas on the theme
   Practise this until you can do it without help.
3. appreciate different creative Arabic writing styles
   Practise this until you can do it without help.

HOW TO SHOW UNDERSTANDING
Explain the idea in your own words, give one Kenyan example, then complete the practice tasks.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Describe Guided Writing: Imaginative Writing using something at your school.

Example 2: Give a home/community example from your county.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Underline the key ideas about Guided Writing: Imaginative Writing above.
2. Explain Guided Writing: Imaginative Writing to a parent using one local example.
3. Write or draw three things that prove you understand Guided Writing: Imaginative Writing.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Guided Writing: Imaginative Writing with school or home examples.
2. Answer: Why is Guided Writing: Imaginative Writing important for a Grade 7 learner?
3. Prepare a one-minute oral presentation for a parent or teacher.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. How can you develop a creative text?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. identify features of imaginative writing for information
2. create a short personal and imaginative text to express ideas on the theme
3. appreciate different creative Arabic writing styles

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original study notes from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
